page.layout: One printed page on the scan, blank except for handwriting and stains: a manuscript ownership inscription in the centre ("Gerardus Abbas Luccensis"), faint pen marks at the top left, and ink blots. No printed text block. The spine and the cover edge at the right are not part of the page.
page.notes: Handwritten ownership inscription, reading "Gerardus Abbas Luccensis" in two lines, is handwriting and therefore not transcribed as printed text. Ink scribbles and blots at the top left and top centre are handwriting or stains and are omitted. The pasted or bound edge at the right shows part of a decorated cover or endpaper, not printed text of this page.
